adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the code appends `"#{url}"` into `contents` with only a `^https?://` regex check (`return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`). A feed-supplied `url` can legally contain a single quote (or other HTML-significant characters) while still matching that prefix, which would break out of the single-quoted `href` attribute and inject arbitrary HTML/JS. This is especially impactful because imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and later rendered with `raw post.cooked`, so the injected markup would be served unescaped.
